b: If you were thinking about starting the New Year with new Festool tools, take advantage of these freebie deals.
Buy a bundle with a select Festool dust collector and select power tool, and you get 2 FREE accessories.
It looks like you get a free filter bag, and a free accessory related to the tool in the bundle.

So with a sander bundle, you get a Systainer with an assortment of sanding sheets. With a track saw, you get a free guide rail. Buy a Domino bundle, and you get an assortment of Domino floating tenons, for free.
They’re accessories you need, or will need, for free.
I haven’t seen Festool run promos like this before. Take advantage of it while you can.
The deals end 12/14/2026, giving you some time to think it over.
